title: Browser identities and target-site mission defaults
summary: Managed browser identities can declare automatic first-party test-account sign-in. Credential fields are machine-local browser-control sign-in.IDENTITY.SITE.FIELD secrets, imported through stdin or files; only secret paths enter the unrecorded headless Playwright sign-in. Human and native Test Machine sign-in remain human. Explicit authorize refreshes the authoritative sign-in profile. Each QA check copies it into a private browser; checks never refresh or stop the authoritative profile. Expired sign-in is fixed by authorizing again before the next check. Mission dispatch offers declared identities with a site on the origin of any of the target's *_url endpoints, listing the project's default_identity first and passing it on walker setup and steps; a mission's method_config.browser_identities list wins.
